where_to_look: Ciena's growth is now hyperscaler DCI, so the edge lives in its customers' disclosures: the 10-K/10-Q customer-concentration note names the >10% customers, and the capex guidance those specific hyperscalers gave in their own July/August quarters is a harder number than any Ciena guide

Component supply: pluggable optics and DSP supply from Coherent/Lumentum/Marvell. Read those suppliers' most recent quarters for lead-time and allocation commentary, which constrains Ciena's ability to convert backlog
Order book vs revenue: Ciena discloses book-to-bill qualitatively. The gap between orders and shipments is where the -13.7% and -12.9% reactions came from even in a growth year
Gross margin mix is the recurring disappointment: line systems dilute margin while WaveLogic drives it. The disaggregation is in the 10-Q, and management's margin guide is the line the market trades
